name: nrfx_nvmc
description: Nordic's nrfx NVMC driver, unmodified, on the nRF52840 DK, each operation timed on TIMER1 at 16 MHz with the core waiting in the flash: FICR's 256 pages of 4 KiB; nrfx_nvmc_page_erase in 85 ms (tERASEPAGE, the value nrfx itself gives as NVMC_PAGE_ERASE_DURATION_MS); three words in 3 x 41 us (tWRITE) and a byte (as its word) in 41 us, read back, a word written over another ANDing with it; nrfx_nvmc_page_partial_erase_continue's 10 ms parts until the driver's sum reaches 85 ms (nine parts, the page erased); an address within a page refused with -EACCES; UICR's CUSTOMER[0] written through the NVMC, then kept through NVIC_SystemReset's reset.

expect.contains: EmbSIM nRF52840 NVMC: 256 pages of 4096 bytes, UICR CUSTOMER[0] 0xffffffff
page erase 0 in 85000 us, first word ffffffff
partial erase 0: 9 parts in 90006 us, first word ffffffff

second boot: CUSTOMER[0] kept, page A 11223344 99aabbcc 5a
done
